description: Scores the 12 AI Practice Risk Check answers from get_risk_check_questions. Returns a score out of 100 (higher is better), results in seven areas (ethics, confidentiality, verification, supervision, vendor risk, cybersecurity, competitive readiness), the three weakest areas with one next step each, and a link to the full report. Answers are not stored. Show only what this tool returns, follow its instructions_for_assistant, and do not add your own action plan or advice.

answers.description: The user's answers to questions 1 to 12, in order, as a, b or c.
